title: skills(checklist-test): the section-4 extraction bullet restates the reproduction obligation with no pointer at rule 2's access-control carve-out
body:
Filed unassigned from the work on #9507 (PR #9606), which aligned the two `docs/qa/platform-checklist` READMEs with RUNNER.md rule 2's authentication/authorization carve-out. `.claude/skills/**` is a governed, human-merge-only surface, so this was reported rather than edited.

## The asymmetry

`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` **does** carry the carve-out — in its Guardrails section (around line 223), where the clause explicitly names what it overrides: section 4's rule that every `fail` owes a reproduction rule, and RUNNER rule 2's identical requirement. That much is correct and needs no change.

What it does not name is section 4's **extraction** bullet (around line 141-144), which tells the runner to extract each product defect into a standalone card with "reproduction and mechanism itemized". PR #9506 added exactly such a pointer to the corresponding paragraph in RUNNER.md:

```
  not carry `qa-run`; it enters triage first-touch normally. An authentication or
  authorization defect is extracted under rule 2's carve-out — item, clause, `detail
  withheld pending maintainer`, no recipe. The extracted card is public too.
```

So RUNNER.md pins the carve-out at both the record bullet and the extraction bullet; the skill pins it at the record bullet only.

## How much this matters

Less than it looks, which is why this is a `finding` rather than a queued defect. The Guardrails clause already says the reproduction goes "not into the run issue, not into a tracking card, not into a comment" — the extracted card is covered in substance. The gap is purely one of reading path: a runner who lands on section 4's extraction bullet alone gets the unconditional instruction and no hint that a carve-out exists. That is the same shape #9507 and #9471 exist to close, one level weaker.

## Suggested shape, if a maintainer takes it

One clause on the section 4 extraction bullet pointing at the skill's own Guardrails carve-out — not a third copy of the policy. #9506's treatment of RUNNER.md is the precedent.

## Verification bound

Found by grepping the repo for both the English (`reproduc`) and Chinese phrasings of the obligation. The English-only sweep reads clean across `.claude/skills/**`, since those skills are written in Chinese; that is worth knowing for anyone repeating the search. Positive controls were run on every file that reported no match.
